title: Aft Tail Booms
label: SOURCED
summary: Twin contoured booms flanking the 2D exhaust nozzles that carry the all-moving horizontal stabilator pivots and shield infrared/radar nozzle signatures from side aspects.
role: Structurally supports the horizontal stabilators and masks nozzle side-aspect thermal emissions.
